external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Anthem Partners (Frisco) recently partnered with Life Celebration Inc. This partnership will enable Anthem locations nationwide to gradually introduce the latter’s program, which offers families distinctive services and fully customized products that honor their loved ones and support the grieving and healing processes.

Starmark Funeral Products formed a new partnership with Spencer, a global leader in casket-handling equipment and body-removal systems. Spencer’s equipment is now available through Starmark, providing funeral professionals with access to both Spencer’s industry-leading solutions and its own products.

Anthem Partners (Frisco) has developed a strategic partnership with Tribute Technology. As the first step of this partnership, all websites serving Anthem Partners locations were updated and moved to the Tribute Technology platform.
